summary: Corrected eBPF history/ABI, modern libbpf examples and concurrency/attachment semantics, current Cilium maps/commands, diagrams and all quiz answers; bounded validation complete with live-kernel limitations explicit.
findings: Replaced removed legacy libbpf maps declarations and undefined u32/u64 examples with BTF .maps and exact types.
Old bpftool load-only examples never attached tracepoints; current loader checks one program before loading, owns attachment/link lifetime, checks errors and closes resources.
Counter now distinguishes execve attempts from successful sched_process_exec events; bounded comm keys are not unique executable paths. Capacity and selected loss counters are explicit.

Native two-thread helper simulation proves BPF_NOEXIST+lookup+atomic increment retains both counts; BPF_ANY mutation loses one. Reader starts with NULL, bounds strings and handles next-key/count/loss failures.
Corrected kernel milestones with17 predecessor/release source comparisons, plus3.18syscall/3.19maps and5.3bounded-loop evidence. Preserved1992preprint/1993USENIX distinction.
Removed absolute verifier/crash/performance guarantees; clarified interpreter/JIT, GPL-helper restrictions, CO-RE limits, unstable tracepoint/kfunc ABI and1M/4096instruction versus analysis limits.
Corrected ringbuf MPSC, map/reference/pin lifetimes, perCPU concurrency and buffer layout, socket-filter capture semantics, nonexistent UPROBE enum and hook-specific returns.
Current Cilium source maps are cilium_lxc/IPCachev2/policyv3/CT/LB/metrics families; replaced fabricated source filenames and generic map keys.
Corrected socket/TC/optionalXDP service paths, userspace L7 proxy versus kernel encryption, removed KafkaL7 API, Beta ztunnel distinction and no QoS guarantees.
Updated node-local cilium-dbg commands, cached map versus kernel view, Hubble Relay/HTTP403 visibility, profile metric arguments and trace_pipe versus verifier logs.
Included documented RHEL8.10 equivalent kernel backport, AMD64/AArch64 and separate native-Cilium Clang18.1 requirement.
Reviewed all40quiz answers; kept20questions per language and aligned explanations. Removed whitespace-only blank lines in Korean quiz.

Cilium1.20.1 startup source rejects tunnel routing plus autoDirectNodeRoutes; removed invalid automatic hybrid-fallback claims. BGP ControlPlane advertises routes but does not program local forwarding.
Corrected VXLAN standardized4789 versusCilium8472, Geneve6081, GREprotocol47, identifier-space and no-encryption/no-overlap-resolution claims.
MTU is the underlying-network override, not final Pod payload size. Source-calculated VXLAN overhead50IPv4/70IPv6, device-versus-route distinction and double-subtraction error explained.
Replaced absolute performance/security rankings and automatic conntrack/XDP/DSR/hugepage optimization claims with feature- and workload-specific reasoning.
Clarified EKS EC2/Fargate/Auto/Hybrid boundaries, upstream ENI versusVPC-CNI branchENI, managedGKE/anetd versusupstream, and managedAKS/delegatedIPAM versusAzureVMIPAM.
Quiz paths contain test guides, not MCQs. Preserved eight guided exercises per language with expected results, replacing repeated CNI uninstall/reinstall loops and obsolete flags.
Manual policy test uses official CLI0.20 image digests/pause/server8080 contract, readiness/EndpointSlice checks, cross-node anti-affinity, both-clients baseline and explicitnamespace CNP.
A failed request is not declared a policy pass: source/port/denied-flow corroboration required. Four native shell fixtures distinguish unexpectedallow from uncorroboratedfailure.
Maintained CLIperf replaces nonexistentnetperf workload assumptions; namespace sequence suffixes, case/sample duration and TCPcontrol+UDPdata distinction documented.
Updated version/CNI/endpoint diagnostics and current standalone cilium bgp peers; optional feature state is interpreted only when configured.
